2611.01747.image_caption: Figure 1: From Fixed Pipelines to Learned Meta-Control. Up: Existing methods typically follow a fixed routine for using and consolidating experience, even when the retrieved experience does not help the current task. Down: OMCE learns from task feedback when to use experience, whether to draw on past cases or general guidance, and when to distill new guidance.

2611.01977.image_caption: Figure 1 . Conventional cascaded recommendation vs. EvoRec. (a) Conventional recommenders rely on predefined pipelines and offline parameter updates. (b) EvoRec integrates autonomous recommendation with reflection-driven self-evolution, using a Dynamic Reflection Tree to diagnose errors and provide personalized repair strategies without updating agent parameters.

2611.02079.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of ParetoSaddler. Repeated execution and statistical Pareto promotion identify candidates for development evaluation. The updated candidate pool and Pareto archive support continued optimization, with final harness selection governed by the deployment preference.

2611.02391.image_caption: Figure 2: (a) The agent edits a general planner for one site, self-tests on public seeds with traces, and is scored only on hidden seeds; experts review the diffs. (b) The tuned site: aisles and station lanes are one-wide corridors, and one cell links the two halves.

2611.02516.image_caption: Figure 1 : Overall framework of EVOLVE. EVOLVE organizes agent defense into generation, reuse, audit, and refinement stages, enabling executable guardrail tools to be generated, fused, verified, and repaired through lifelong interaction.

2611.03126.image_caption: Figure 1 : Performance comparisons of our proposed CUA-Master-27B and other counterparts across four benchmarks.

2611.03238.image_caption: Figure 2: Motivation for resource-to-skill construction. (a) Scientific applications and their resources. (b) Human-oriented narrative content. (c) Sparse task-relevant information. (d) Effects of directly injecting raw resources on success rate and total execution time.

2611.03618.image_caption: Figure 3 : The Strategy Blueprint is a freeform graph that grows through the library. (a) Two foundations ( chat and agent ) sit at the top. Strategies compose from them and from each other, forming a directed graph whose levels emerge naturally from composition depth. (b) Four protocols govern the graph: every node shares one abstract interface, each node can only call nodes created before it, no cycles are allowed, and no duplicates should exist.

2611.00344.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of the SPARK correction loop. Episode 1 flies the source waypoints under a degraded view and builds memory H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} from its own RGB-D observations (1–2). The semantic critic reads H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} and the Episode 1 images alone, flagging regions by plausibility, density, and graph coverage (3). The planner turns those into viewpoints offset from the source waypoints for Episode 2 (4), and the selective merge removes, replaces, and adds entries to produce H ( 2 ) H^{(2)} (5), which a fixed EQA set scores against H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} (6). The oracle (blue) is evaluation-only and never reaches the critic, planner, or merge.

2611.00450.image_caption: Figure 1: Training pipelines. (a) MLP Memory fits a memory alone to kNN targets; the base enters only at inference (Eq. 5 ). (b) ResMem fits a logit residual so that base plus residual matches an evidence-reading teacher; inference drops the teacher and scales the residual by γ \gamma (Eq. 3 ).

2611.01115.image_caption: Figure 1: CompSkill on ToolQA: the semantic Top-10 offers a lookup guide; events recall the missing listings guide, which KeyOpt ranks first and cited review keeps.

2611.01415.image_caption: Figure 1: Latent Harness compiles external conditions into post-block activation shifts. Teacher traces or strictly filtered success trajectories train a rank-8 shift at every block output of a frozen backbone. The bundle injects at run time with strength, phase, and mixing controls.

2611.01460.image_caption: Figure 1 : Overview of learning paradigms for LLM agents, comparing parametric and non-parametric approaches along the dimensions of stored knowledge, inference-time usage, and update mechanism.

2611.01581.image_caption: Fig. 1: An LLM-agent framework for exoskeleton assistance policy generation, execution, and feedback-based refinement. The policy implementation module generates executable code from task requirements, hardware information, and a unified control interface. Candidate code undergoes checks before becoming an available policy version. The local execution framework loads and runs the selected policy during a trial started and ended by the operator. During execution, the framework exchanges joint-state information and torque commands with the exoskeleton. EMG results, task completion, and participant feedback inform policy assessment. The feedback analysis module either proposes a revision based on a selected policy or selects an existing policy for reuse. Code revisions and policy-version selection occur between trials. Solid arrows indicate execution or data flow; dashed arrows indicate revision or reuse decisions.

2611.00452.image_caption: Figure 2: Compositional self-improvement expands the range of instances solved by the model. Each heatmap shows accuracy across self-improvement rounds. From left to right: grid navigation by the number of rooms, addition by addend digit length, and max run length by string length. In all three tasks, reliable prediction extends beyond the initial model’s reliable range.

2611.01718.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of MemUse. The memory bridge connects agents to memory systems and annotates memory operations. The trajectory recorder captures model calls, with token usage and cost when available. Within each episode, data processing groups identical repeated deliveries into injection spans while earlier copies remain visible and assigns each entry a credit window for attributing actions. The memory graph links deliveries to recorded entry histories across trajectories. For each eligible span, an agentic judge assesses each entry’s information quality, use, and observed effects from its exposed text, prior context, and subsequent trajectory. Programmatic checks enforce evidence coverage and credit windows, and fixed rules derive the span verdict.

2611.01976.image_caption: Figure 1 . The tool update gap. A malicious update preserves the tool’s legitimate functionality while introducing unauthorized operations that execute directly within the tool’s runtime environment.
